blocks.text:
The price is per person sharing a TWIN room, for a minimum group of 20 participants.

## Rio for MICE

Rio de Janeiro is an excellent destination for meetings, incentive travel, conferences and exhibitions.

Corporate groups can combine a business agenda with a varied leisure programme in one city. The itinerary includes excursions to major landmarks, cultural activities, group dinners and a day trip to tropical islands.

The city offers convention venues, high-standard hotels and transport infrastructure for international groups.

Accommodation is at the five-star Miramar by Windsor hotel or a similar property.

## Corporate Programme Format

Excursions are conducted with an English-speaking guide.

Main transfers are accompanied by an English-speaking guide.

Accommodation is at a 5-star hotel, Miramar by Windsor or similar.

Hotel breakfasts are included.

The programme also includes shared meals: a welcome dinner on the first day, lunches on excursion days, dinners at the hotel and a farewell dinner at Fogo de Chão.

Ada Tours may adjust the sequence of individual excursions while preserving the overall programme.
